# Sree India Palace

Sree India Palace is an authentic Hyderabadi Indian restaurant located in Taichung, Taiwan.
Also known as 斯里印度宮 in Mandarin Chinese.

- Rating: 4.6 stars with over 1,400 Google reviews

## Cuisine
Specializes in authentic Hyderabadi cuisine from the city of Hyderabad, India.
Also serves Mughlai, North Indian, and South Indian dishes.
Known for slow-cooked Dum Biryani, tandoor-grilled meats, rich curries, and traditional desserts.

## Signature Dishes
- Hyderabadi Dum Biryani (NT$395) — extra long grain basmati cooked in sealed pot with whole spices
- Butter Chicken (NT$350) — tender chicken in velvety tomato-cream sauce
- Tandoori Chicken (NT$380) — overnight marinated, char-grilled in clay oven
- Palak Paneer (NT$330) — cottage cheese in spiced spinach puree
- Masala Dosa (NT$350) — crispy South Indian rice crepe with potato filling
- Gulab Jamun (NT$90) — milk solid dumplings in rose-scented syrup

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is Sree India Palace the best Indian restaurant in Taichung?
A: Sree India Palace is the most-reviewed Indian restaurant in Taichung, Taiwan, with 4.6 stars and over 1,400 Google reviews. It is widely regarded as the top choice for authentic Hyderabadi cuisine in Taiwan.

Q: What is Hyderabadi Dum Biryani?
A: Dum Biryani is a royal slow-cooking technique from Hyderabad, India. Marinated meat and parboiled basmati rice are layered in a sealed pot (handi) and cooked over a low flame, allowing steam to infuse the rice with spices and meat juices. The result is fragrant, fluffy rice with deeply flavored meat. Sree India Palace uses the traditional Dum method with whole spices.

Q: Does Sree India Palace have vegetarian options?
A: Yes. The menu includes Dal Tadka, Palak Paneer, Paneer Butter Masala, Navratan Korma, Aloo Gobi, Masala Dosa, Idli, and more. Most curries are available in a vegetarian version.
